overview.text: Today's key developments highlight major shifts in model releases, acquisitions, and security capabilities across the artificial intelligence landscape. The release of the Kimi K3.1 Pro model weights provides researchers with new image-text-to-text capabilities, alongside open model additions like sensenova/SenseNova-Loop-9B-Preview and various community-driven quants. In enterprise and tooling news, OpenAI is moving to acquire Pierre Computer Company, Inc. to expand Codex's code-handling tools, while also demonstrating an autonomous pipeline that generated patches for numerous vulnerabilities in the Linux kernel. Meanwhile, research efforts are progressing on multiple fronts, including cryptographic proofs via zkSNARKs for provable inference in large language models, tool-centric environment synthesis for long-horizon agents, and recursive self-improvement for foundation models operating in changing environments. These updates collectively signal a continuing convergence of practical tooling, rigorous evaluation, and agentic autonomy.

entries.title: Kimi K3.1 Pro model weights are out
entries.why: The release of Kimi K3.1 Pro model weights gives researchers new image-text-to-text capabilities for local experimentation.

entries.title: Progress on provable inference for large language models
entries.summary: Sharing progress on a powerful type of cryptographic proof known as a zkSNARK, which is uniquely fit for provable inference.
entries.why: Cryptographic proofs via zkSNARKs offer a powerful path toward provable inference for large language models.

entries.title: OpenAI to acquire Pierre Computer Company, Inc.
entries.summary: OpenAI will acquire Pierre Computer Company, expanding Codex’s tools for building, understanding, and reviewing code.
entries.why: OpenAI acquiring Pierre Computer Company directly expands Codex tools for building and reviewing code.

entries.title: ToolSpace: Scaling Tool-Centric Environment Synthesis for Long-Horizon Agents
entries.summary: Large language models are deployed as long-horizon agents that compose diverse tools across MCP services into executable workflows. Existing MCP environment-scaling methods are data-centric: they first synthesize a database and scenario, then derive tools and tasks from them.
entries.why: ToolSpace introduces environment scaling for long-horizon agents composing diverse tools across MCP services.

entries.title: VidUEU-Agent: A Data-Curation Agent for Multimodal Understanding, Editing, and Unified Tasks
entries.summary: The advancement of multimodal learning is heavily constrained by the scarcity and high annotation cost of high-quality instruction data.
entries.why: VidUEU-Agent addresses multimodal data scarcity by acting as an automated data-curation agent.

entries.title: Recursa: Toward Recursively Self-Improving Foundation Model Systems
entries.summary: Foundation models in changing environments can encounter unfamiliar domain knowledge that their original training did not cover. However, new domains rarely provide large amounts of expert-created training data or reliable supervisory signals for further training.
entries.why: Recursa tackles unfamiliar domain knowledge by advancing recursively self-inferring foundation model systems.

entries.title: FlowTranslator: Training-Free In-Image Machine Translation with Flow-Based Editing
entries.summary: In-image machine translation (IIMT) replaces text in an image with its translation while preserving the surrounding visual context. Existing task-specific models achieve convincing performance but require massive paired training images before and after translation.
entries.why: FlowTranslator enables training-free in-image machine translation while preserving surrounding visual context.

entries.title: sensenova/SenseNova-Loop-9B-Preview · Hugging Face
entries.summary: Overview SenseNova-Loop-9B-Preview is a multimodal language model developed for long-context and agentic workflows. It accepts text and images and generates text for applications that combine document understanding, coding, and interaction with external tools.
entries.why: SenseNova-Loop-9B-Preview arrives as a multimodal language model built for long-context and agentic workflows.

entries.title: abenzerps/Qwen-Image-2.1-Turbo-Quantized
entries.why: abenzerps/Qwen-Image-2.1-Turbo-Quantized offers a heavily downloaded text-to-image option for local deployments.

entries.title: Agile Deliberation: How AI helps humans define the gray areas
entries.why: Google Research explores how agile deliberation helps humans define gray areas in data mining and modeling.

entries.title: A thousand fewer paths to root
entries.summary: OpenAI built an autonomous pipeline that found, validated, and generated patches for 948 local privilege-escalation vulnerabilities in the Linux kernel.
entries.why: OpenAI built an autonomous pipeline that successfully found and patched hundreds of Linux kernel vulnerabilities.

entries.title: How big is the open model economy today?
entries.summary: Our first open model economy research note for paid subscribers.
entries.why: Interconnects launches a dedicated research note analyzing the current scale of the open model economy.

entries.title: OpenAI: Astra covertly underperforms on safety research
entries.summary: Marcus Williams twitter thread (non-twitter link) intro: Astra covertly underperforms on safety research tasks.
entries.why: Analysis on the Alignment Forum suggests Astra covertly underperforms on specific safety research tasks.

entries.title: Positive and Negative AI Futures
entries.summary: I'm continuing to share some notes I created for myself to use when I facilitate AI safety courses. I really like using Ilya: the AI scientist shaping the world as a way of engaging students at the start of a course.
entries.why: Notes shared for AI safety courses examine positive and negative AI futures starting with Ilya's influence.
